status: proposed; not executed; requires review before collection
kind: benchmark protocol; not a product/domain schema or implemented runner
case_status: All preparation, behavior, timing, replay and negative controls: NOT RUN

product.build: GOWORK=off CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 GOAMD64=v1 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -o BINARY ./cmd/mousa

question: Whole fresh-process native command cost including runtime startup, verification, command work, output and exit; not isolated verification time

workload.source_labels: fixture/startup/00 through first S zero-padded indices

declaration.author: fixture-author
declaration.pins: exact predecessor and successor native-created item representations

events.construction: root selects declaration; even events deactivate; later odd events reactivate; exact previous event required
events.zero: no events or current-state projection, not deactivation

workload.trail_gate: After all events: allow, two matched candidates, v4, consulted=true; E=0 selects both with null administration; E>0 selects successor and withholds predecessor with final tip/declaration and excluded=1
workload.variable_bytes: Report actual store and sidecar bytes; history/index pages and v4 references confound isolated verification attribution
workload.preparation: Native sync and administration only; reviewed preparation codec derivation checked against native records; no SQL fabrication of valid history; native random request identities retained, not cross-capture byte-equality goldens
workload.snapshot: Quiescent SQLite backup API, destination truncating checkpoint and close, integrity/logical equivalence checks; fresh byte-verified closed snapshot copy for every invocation

operations.name: declaration-get
operations.effects: Main database bytes and all logical/canonical records unchanged; record WAL/SHM and other sidecar lifecycle separately, without immutable-mode substitution

operations.name: status
operations.open: writable; preflight then current-schema verification and FTS integrity check
operations.comparison: strict JSON, duplicate-key rejection, type-preserving canonical equality
operations.effects: No logical changes or audit appends; record physical WAL/SHM/FTS effects explicitly

invocation_paths: From scratch root: ./bin/mousa -store trial/store.sqlite; replace trial directory per call; exact relative argv/cwd and explicit public-safe effective environment, no stream rewriting

schedule.order: warmup rounds 0,1 then measured rounds 0..9; each round contains all cells sorted by ascending SHA256 UTF-8(seed|PHASE|ROUND|S|E|T|OP), decimal unpadded integers, PHASE warmup or measured, OP declaration-get or status; full string byte-order tie break
schedule.freeze: Expanded schedule with ordinals, argv/stdin/fixture/output identities and SHA256 before warmups
schedule.cache: process-cold; ordinary OS cache, not cold-page-cache; no privileged eviction or global tuning
schedule.contention: Retain and flag all observations; interruption, suspension, sampler failure or concurrent workload stops attempt; no favorable replacements

metrics.wall: monotonic_ns immediately before child creation through wait4 reaping, ns; stdout/stderr regular-file output included
metrics.cpu: wait4 for exact direct child PID: ru_utime and ru_stime seconds
metrics.rss: Linux wait4 ru_maxrss KiB (1024 bytes), not wrapper historic maximum, cumulative child counters, Go allocations or simultaneous tree sum
metrics.storage: main, WAL, SHM, journal sizes/hashes and pre/post logical snapshots for both operations; read-only get preserves main-file bytes, not every sidecar byte

wait.mechanism: pidfd exit readiness via select.poll then exactly one blocking wait4(pid,0); no WNOHANG/sleep loop or fallback
wait.deadlines: check immediately before and after every poll return; zero wait when due
wait.reap_priority: ready child is reaped before a due storage check
wait.receipts: poll start/end/requested timeout, readiness observation, wait4 return, deadline/storage checks, actual detection/termination delay and resource-bound overshoot
wait.support: missing or denied APIs fail preflight before preparation/collection
wait.scheduling: event wakes poll without waiting for timeout; requested cadences do not guarantee hard real-time scheduling; monitoring overhead remains included

metrics.summaries: Successful per-cell n, median (even n: arithmetic mean central pair), minimum and maximum; incomplete cells labeled; no tail percentiles

bounds.storage_accounting: Combined workspace including preparation, failed attempts and packaging; log phase totals separately; one trial copy at a time; fixed bytes accounted before spawn plus live trial/output checks every100ms; actual detection overshoot retained
bounds.completion: 400 deadlines can exceed phase cap; full coverage not guaranteed
bounds.failure: Stop first failed gate/timeout/infrastructure error/cancellation; SIGTERM group, SIGKILL after grace, reap; retain raw failure and remaining NOT RUN entries; no retries, trimming, imputation or outcome-driven limit changes
bounds.preparation_failure: Stop before collection and mark whole unstarted schedule NOT RUN

required_receipts: clean product/companion commits and trees; accepted protocol commit/hash
build command, toolchain, verified modules, complete effective environment, binary SHA256
fixture inputs, native preparation invocations, canonical identities, hashes and coherent snapshot identities
frozen expanded schedule and SHA256; each raw invocation bound to its ordinal
every invocation exact relative argv/cwd, stdin bytes/hash, exit/signal, lossless stdout/stderr bytes/hashes, phase and UTC times
trial monotonic endpoints, wall ns, per-child user/system CPU seconds, RSS KiB and censor/termination reason
event-driven wait and monitor receipts: requested poll intervals, actual start/end/readiness/reap/deadline/storage times, delays and overshoot
pre/post all-table typed logical snapshots, schema, counts, canonical digests and database/sidecar sizes/hashes; immutable seed before/after checks
host CPU/features, RAM, kernel, filesystem/storage, cgroups/limits, load, readable governors, pressure/throttling and missing-counter records
failure/NOT RUN coverage, negative mutation specifications/false conditions/detectors and real forbidden-write receipts
archive member names/sizes/SHA256, compressed package and whole patch/blob sizes; capture/publication/merge identities separate
negative_controls: failure exit rewritten to success with passed=true
broken declaration bytes or status JSON type
wrong wait mechanism/cadence or missing monitor records
ordinary_controls: status JSON key order change passes; declaration byte changes reject
control-only 1000ms pidfd readiness wait wakes on exit; measured waits remain at most1ms; missing support fails preflight
read-only sidecar lifecycle retained separately while main/logical invariants hold

publication.layout: One additive results/YYYY-MM-DD-startup-verification directory with README, protocol, pins, schedule, tables/plots, control receipts, manifest, capture.tar.gz and archive-members.json
publication.archive: Lossless raw receipts/input/preparation/logical snapshots/host records/failures/tool source; regular relative non-traversing members only, no links or duplicates; local DB/binary hashes, not committed stores/binaries
publication.overflow: Preserve locally and stop for separate reviewed publication proposal; no evidence deletion or control exceptions
publication.verifiers: Shared archive verifier checks bytes/membership, not measured conclusions; future analyzer derives gates and summaries from raw receipts, not passed booleans
publication.identities: Capture-time sources distinct from later publication/merge; no self-referential eventual commit requirement

review: Independent acceptance pending; proposed choices in README require ratification before later implementation/capture; no silent adaptation to results
